messages:
Zoe - Partnerships: Partner onsite (on-prem PCIe cluster) reported intermittent kernel panics after we published marketplace images with driver 546. Theyre asking if we can freeze the image set before their integration run next week. Ticket: https://redwood-internal/partners/P-2102 :worried:
Ken - Eng Infra: Any crash dumps or kernel oops yet? If they can send narrow repro commands I can run an isolated repro in our lab.
Maya - Runtime: I ran a quick stress test overnight on PCIe A100 and saw a panic when the driver tried to create a large pinned allocation during long KV-cache lifetimes. 546 reproduces, 542 is stable.
Rajat - Marketplace: We planned to flip stable->546 today to align with vendor perf notes. Given this, proposal: pin stable to 542, create an "experimental-546" channel, and hold the co-marketing announcement until infra signs off.
WatcherBot: canary-job created: CAN-2102 / pcie-stress / started. https://ci.redwood/test/CAN-2102
Ken - Eng Infra: Ill run matrix (542, 546) on PCIe nodes and collect dmesg + vmcore. If CI reproduces I will open vendor escalation with crash dump. Contact: drv-escalate@vendor.example.com.
Maya - Runtime: Runtime acceptance criteria for 546: no kernel oops during 24h stress with batch>=16, KV cache stable across requests, and perf within 7% of baseline.
Zoe - Partnerships: For partner messaging I suggest: "We've paused the broad flip to driver 546 and pinned our stable images to 542 while we validate a vendor patch. We'll offer a private test image on request." I'll draft and send to partner PMs.
Rajat - Marketplace: Hold applied: marketplace/stable -> driver 542. experimental -> 546 with big-warning and opt-in. Ill also add a note in marketplace release notes about the hold and mention the co-marketing slide deck delay.
WatcherBot: CAN-2102 finished - PCIe with 546 = FAIL (kernel panic), 542 = PASS. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/test/CAN-2102/logs
Ken - Eng Infra: Confirmed panic in CI. Opening bug BR-860 and attaching vmcore and nv-crash logs. Escalating to vendor with priority-high.
Maya - Runtime: I'll add a quick preflight check in our onboarding script to detect driver==546 and print a warning with link to the hold doc. Also adding an automated trace collector for vmcore on CI.
Zoe - Partnerships: I'll delay public announcement and update joint-announcement owners. Can still run partner POC on pinned 542 image. Sending legal/PM a heads-up now. :white_check_mark:
Rajat - Marketplace: Will keep the hold until infra posts green and vendor provides a validated candidate. I'll publish a small partner FAQ and opt-in instructions for experimental images.
Ken - Eng Infra: Once vendor provides candidate patch, infra will validate and post sign-off in this thread. Owning validation & sign-off.
